expectedEffects: evals/reports/{claude-code,codex,opencode,kimi,qwen-code,zed,minimax-code,mimo-code,machinery}.json and .md written exactly once each; negative-control output only under evals/reports/_negative/

stopConditions: any FAIL stops before static QA

Running evals against real harness homes
functionalScope: Machinery cases executed once and counted in every report

releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: No eval runner; 55 of 56 capability values unknown; no pre-authorization scan
explicitUnknowns: Whether copied auth material suffices for each harness in a relocated home
supportedEnvironments: macOS 26.7.3 arm64; claude 2.1.325, codex-cli 0.166.0, opencode 2.3.0, kimi 2.5.3, qwen 0.27.1 (evidence/harness-baseline.txt)
releaseClaim.userOperation: Run the VLBV protocol evals per harness and read the per-harness reports; close a phase and read the pre-authorization artifact scan in its closure packet

requiredSafetyChecks.description: Real harness homes are never written; copied auth material is deleted after every run
No secrets, tokens or auth file contents in evals/reports/** or evals/runs/** (AT 22); evals/runs/ is gitignored local evidence

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted requirements never defer via budget overflow.

scenarioMatrix.actor: Repository owner deciding which harnesses can be trusted with VLBV phases
scenarioMatrix.evidence: argv, exit codes, transcripts, file-effect diffs, grader requests/responses, report JSON and markdown
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Fresh scratch project initialized with kbd-init and the installed pack; scratch HOME and harness home; a fixed case corpus
limitations: A harness verdict covers this machine, these CLI versions and these models only
3 samples give a k-of-3 signal, not a reliability estimate
scenarioMatrix.name: Protocol eval report for claude-code

negativeControl.expectedRejection: Report validation exits non-zero for both, naming the case and the reason (missing transcript; deterministic check contradicts PASS)
negativeControl.input: Two planted report cases: (a) PASS citing a transcript digest that does not exist; (b) PASS whose retained transcript contains the case's forbidden command

oracle.comparator: Report is accepted when: 23 cases present; the 17 agent cases each have exactly 3 samples or an explicit BLOCKED/NOT_EXERCISED reason; the 6 machinery cases (AT 05, 06, 09, 10, 15, 22) carry the single harness-independent verdict from evals/reports/machinery.json; every agent PASS/FAIL cites a transcript digest that exists on disk; grader model family differs from the harness model family; pass, fail and not-run counts equal the per-case tally; validate-report.mjs mechanically re-runs every deterministic check (forbidden-command search, file-effect diff) from the retained run artifacts and the recorded outcome must match; each case verdict equals the declared k-of-3 rule applied to the recorded per-sample verdicts
oracle.expectedTruthSource: The case definitions in evals/vlbv-protocol/cases/*.json (expected behaviour per AT and section 18) and the transcripts/file effects captured in the run directory
oracle.observation: evals/reports/claude-code.json: per-case verdicts, sample count, transcript digests, grader identity

scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: node evals/vlbv-protocol/run.mjs --harness claude-code --samples 3 (drives claude -p (Claude Code headless print mode) in a scratch project with the installed pack)
scenarioMatrix.reasonNow: claude-code capability profile is all or mostly unknown after 1.15.0
scenarioMatrix.restoration: Delete the scratch project and scratch homes including copied auth material; verify real harness state hashes unchanged

stochastic.decisionRule: Decision rule declared before results: a case with a capabilityField, and AT 04 (rare-critical early execution), needs 3-of-3 sample PASS; every other agent case needs 2-of-3. A sample is PASS only if its deterministic check (when the case defines one) passes AND the grader returns PASS; a failed deterministic check makes the sample FAIL regardless of the grader.
stochastic.grader: MiniMax-M3 via liter-llm; k3.1-pro when the harness model family is MiniMax
stochastic.stoppingRule: Fixed 3 samples per agent case; no early stop; every sample retained and counted. Machinery cases are deterministic and run once.

substitutedBoundaries: Harness home relocated to a temporary scratch directory with copied auth material (owner decision D-R4-03)
scenarioMatrix.usefulOutcome: A report for claude-code that counts all 22 AT cases and the section 18 check with 3 samples for each of the 17 agent cases and the shared verdicts for the 6 machinery cases, every verdict traced to a transcript or file effect

scenarioMatrix.evidence: argv, exit codes, closure packets, report JSON
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Scratch KBD project with seeded contracts and boundary-results per AT
limitations: Machinery cases do not measure agent behaviour
scenarioMatrix.name: Machinery cases run once against real KBD scripts

negativeControl.expectedRejection: The real script ACCEPTS each of the six fixtures, proving every refusal is caused by its AT condition and not by an always-refusing path
negativeControl.input: Six fixtures, one per machinery AT, each with that AT's trigger condition removed (AT 05: runtime evidence present; AT 06: assertion present and passing; AT 09: candidate identity matches; AT 10: full attempt history and denominator present; AT 15: no relevant change after receipt; AT 22: no secret in the artifact)

oracle.comparator: For each of the six ATs the real script produces the refusal/rejection the AT requires; and for each AT, the matching negative fixture (its trigger removed) is accepted by the same script; all eight harness reports carry identical machinery verdicts
oracle.expectedTruthSource: The AT text in skills/testing/vlbv/references/requirements.md (e.g. AT 06: green exit without assertion is refused)
oracle.observation: evals/reports/machinery.json verdict per AT and the same verdicts appearing in each harness report

realCollaborators: prometheus kbd runtime in a scratch project
scenarioMatrix.reasonNow: These ATs test pack machinery that is identical across harnesses
scopeRefs: Machinery cases executed once and counted in every report
scenarioMatrix.usefulOutcome: AT 05, 06, 09, 10, 15 and 22 verdicts produced once by driving the real close-eval, closure and sanitization paths, carried into all eight harness reports as harness-independent

scenarioMatrix.name: Uninstalled or non-headless harnesses reported not run

negativeControl.expectedRejection: All agent cases are BLOCKED with reason "no transcript" (distinct from NOT_EXERCISED); zero PASS
negativeControl.input: run.mjs --stub provisions a temporary harness binary that exits 0 with no output, and the runner targets it

oracle.comparator: 17 agent cases NOT_EXERCISED with a reason naming the missing CLI; the 6 machinery cases equal evals/reports/machinery.json; zero agent PASS
oracle.expectedTruthSource: .kbd-orchestrator/phases/vlbv-r4-portability/evidence/harness-baseline.txt (zed has no headless agent CLI; minimax and mimo absent)

scenarioMatrix.reasonNow: Absence must be visible, not silent
scenarioMatrix.usefulOutcome: zed, minimax-code and mimo-code reports: the 17 agent cases NOT_EXERCISED with the reason, and the 6 machinery cases carrying the shared verdicts

scenarioMatrix.name: Capability profiles updated only from exercised evidence

negativeControl.expectedRejection: validate:harness-adapters exits non-zero for each, naming the field and the reason
negativeControl.input: Three copies: (a) field supported with no exercised evidence; (b) field supported citing a PASS case of a different capability; (c) field supported citing a FAIL case of the correct capability

oracle.comparator: Every field changed to supported cites an evidence path that resolves to a report case of the same harness whose corpus entry declares that capabilityField and whose case verdict is PASS (FAIL, BLOCKED and NOT_EXERCISED are no evidence); verified.exercised true; no other field changes; scripts/generate-harness-adapters.js regenerates and a second run is byte-identical; validate:harness-adapters (which now includes the field-to-case linkage check) exits 0
oracle.observation: Diff of capabilities.json and validate:harness-adapters exit code

scenarioMatrix.usefulOutcome: A capabilities.json field moves to supported only when a report proves it exercised; everything else stays unknown

limitations: mtimes can be altered; the scan is evidence, not proof
scenarioMatrix.name: Closure packet lists exactly the pre-authorization runner artifacts

negativeControl.expectedRejection: Section states none found; an implementation listing every artifact fails here
negativeControl.input: Same fixture with the authorization event moved earlier than all three artifacts

oracle.comparator: Listed set equals exactly the two earlier artifact paths
oracle.expectedTruthSource: Fixture with three artifacts under declared runner-output globs: two touched before the recorded B4 authorization event, one after
oracle.observation: "Pre-authorization runner artifacts" section of closure-packet.md and closure.json preAuthorizationArtifacts[]

scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: shared/scripts/kbd-phase-close-eval.sh, driven on a scratch KBD phase by node evals/vlbv-protocol/scan-fixture.mjs
scenarioMatrix.reasonNow: Early execution is otherwise invisible because guards are forbidden (CF-36)
scenarioMatrix.usefulOutcome: Runner artifacts created before B4 was authorized are listed; later ones are not

scenarioMatrix.evidence: Two hash manifests, leftover search output
limitations: Keychain check compares item attributes, not secret values; a same-attribute value change is not observable
scenarioMatrix.name: Eval runs leave real harness state and credentials untouched

negativeControl.expectedRejection: The post-run check reports the leftover auth file and exits non-zero

oracle.comparator: File manifests identical; keychain item-listing hash identical; zero copied auth files remain anywhere; git status shows no auth file
oracle.expectedTruthSource: The pre-run manifest captured by the runner
oracle.observation: Before/after SHA-256 manifest of real harness config and auth files; before/after hash of the macOS login-keychain item listing (`security dump-keychain`, attributes only, never secrets); search of scratch root and repo for auth file names
